summary.plain: A muon spectrometer behind a lead target with detectors that measure how central each collision is, so physicists could compare J/psi production with the expected normal absorption.
summary.technical: NA50: beam hodoscope and anti-halo counters, three centrality detectors (electromagnetic calorimeter for transverse energy, zero-degree calorimeter, multiplicity detector) and a muon spectrometer behind a hadron absorber (beryllium oxide, carbon, iron) with multi-wire proportional chambers.

technology.quote: The NA50 apparatus consists essentially of a set of beam and anti-halo counters, three centrality detectors, and a muon spectrometer.
technology.value: Muon spectrometer with centrality detectors and a hadron absorber
